entries.title: Stranded Deep

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best current route because it has the complete 1.0 PC release, ongoing PC patch support, and the most flexible capture/settings path. PS4, Xbox One, and Switch are valid console access routes, but they do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Epic Games Store, or Microsoft Store. Use console versions only if that access route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: There is no separate remaster. Stranded Deep 2 has been announced as a future sequel, but it does not yet have enough playable platform/release information for a best-version entry.
